question: Which mission by the Indian Government, launched in 2023, aims to develop quantum technologies and has established four Thematic Hubs across premier institutions, as of 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Quantum Mission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Quantum Mission (NQM)** was launched by the **Indian Government** in **2023** to foster advancements in **quantum technologies**.
 
• The mission aims to establish **four Thematic Hubs (T-Hubs)** in leading academic and research institutions across **India**, focusing on specific aspects of quantum technology such as **quantum computing, sensing, communication, and materials.**
